scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
other_conditions: Applicant must be at least 10th pass with science and possess basic computer knowledge
Applicant or entrepreneur group must have own premises or a rented building with a lease agreement for at least four years
benefits_summary: Provides affordable village‑level soil testing services, enabling farmers to get timely, accurate analyses and customized nutrient recommendations while creating employment for rural youth.
